en.hubeali: From him, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Do not let the decency go away between you and your brother, preserve from it, for if it goes away, the bashfulness would go away’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama’a who has said the following: “
I heard abu al-Hassan Musa saying, ‘Keep your decorum intact between yourself and your brother (friend) and preserve it; removal is the elimination of bashfulness.’”
